preconditions.expression: isinstance(A, list) and all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: A is a list of strings.
The number of strings in A is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(A[0]) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All strings in A have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All characters in the strings of A are lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer.
The return value is between 0 and the length of the strings in A.

postconditions.expression: all(all(A[i][j] <= A[i][j+1] for j in range(len(A[i])-1) if j not in deleted_indices) for i in range(len(A)))
postconditions.description: After deleting the columns specified by the return value, each string in A is lexicographically sorted.
